matchmaker.title: Who you're looking for
matchmaker.intro: Describe the partner you hope for, the way you would tell a family elder. Say what matters most, and what doesn't.
matchmaker.placeholder: For example: a vegetarian family, Hyderabad or Bengaluru, doesn't drink. A master's degree would be nice. Height doesn't matter much.
matchmaker.aiNote: Our AI reads these words only to understand them. Nobody else sees them.
matchmaker.basicNote: We picked out the points below from your words. Change anything we got wrong.
matchmaker.understoodHint: Slide to say how much each point matters. At 10 it is a must — people who clearly don't meet it are not shown.
matchmaker.nothing: Nothing to match on yet. Name a city, a diet, an age or an education — or add a point below.

scales.partnerHint: Where you would like them to be on each scale, and how much it matters. Leave a scale unset if it doesn't.
scales.selfHint: Where you are on each scale. Private — only the matching reads it.
